To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the web-service oriented architecture is a good candidate to support the design and development in the e-commerce domain.

(i) the use of web services technology for the development of on-line electronic payment systems is a feasible solution and (ii) the use of a web services oriented architecture for the design and development is an effective approach.
web services oriented architecture can be successfully used for designing and developing on-line payment applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a set of web-services that can be used by third parties to provide electronic payment services.
the design of an authentication web-service for the electronic payment applications.
the design and implementation of a web-services oriented solution for on-line payment applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of web services in a SOA is a good approach to the design and development process of web-based applications.
a web-services oriented design is the most appropriate approach to the design and development for a distributed and heterogeneous environment.
the web services oriented architecture is a promising technology for the development of distributed applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of web-services is an effective approach in the migration from the traditional application architecture to a more modern one.
we have successfully developed a web-services oriented authentication service for the electronic payment system.

the web-services oriented architecture is a good solution for the design and development process of a complex web application, and that web-services technology is a promising technology to build a new generation of web applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
web-services are a promising technology to support the design and development process of web applications.
a web-services oriented approach can provide a flexible and scalable solution for the design and development on-line electronic payment systems.
a web-services oriented approach can be successfully applied in the development of a web application, even when the application is not originally designed for web-services.
